name: Other Parties 45
definition: Provides details about business parties involved in the transaction.

Investor.name: Investor
Investor.definition: Party that identifies the underlying investor.

StockExchange.name: Stock Exchange
StockExchange.definition: Party that identifies the stock exchange.

TradeRegulator.name: Trade Regulator
TradeRegulator.definition: Party that identifies the trade regulator.

QualifiedForeignIntermediary.name: Qualified Foreign Intermediary
QualifiedForeignIntermediary.definition: Foreign Financial Institution which has been authorised by local authorities to act as account management institution in the country.

InvestorUsageRule.definition: When investor is used with a country code, the country code specifies the nationality of the investor, for the settlement of certain securities (i.e. airlines, defence manufacturers) under the EU legislation.

QualifiedForeignIntermediaryRule.definition: If Qualified Foreign Intermediary is used, then the instruction must be a delivery.
